answer: Farming becomes a voyage bet on surviving 76 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the dune schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 76 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
